mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bookmark WHERE m_code = #{m_code} AND b_code = #{b_code}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookmark WHERE m_code = #{m_code}

SELECT b.b_code, b.b_title, b.b_image, m.m_nick, 1 as isBookmarked FROM board b JOIN bookmark bm ON b.b_code = bm.b_code JOIN member m ON b.m_code = m.m_code WHERE bm.m_code = #{m_code} ORDER BY bm.reg_date DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{amount} ROWS ONLY
